reasoning: According to research from the Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance (Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index - CBECI) and reports cited by major institutions (such as the BBC and Columbia University's Climate School), Bitcoin's estimated annual electricity consumption (ranging from 120 to over 150 TWh per year in recent years) surpasses the annual electricity consumption of countries like Argentina (approx. 121–130 TWh). Multiple independent analyses confirm this comparison.
